address: 港汇恒隆广场 (Grand Gateway 66), 徐汇区, 上海市 — L6 (North Tower, near the cinema / 北座近影院)
description_en: Chaoshan-style sweet dessert soup shop with customizable toppings. Two base options: snow fungus and milk. Popular toppings include peach gum, Chaoshan tangyuan, and cassava.
description_zh: 潮汕风味甜汤店，可自选配料。两种汤底：雪耳和牛奶。热门配料包括桃胶、潮汕汤圆和木薯。
